description: This file implements a shell script for configuring and managing IPv6-in-IPv4 tunneling, specifically the 6in4 protocol, within the OpenWrt router firmware. It provides functions for setting up, updating, and tearing down the tunnel, including address configuration, route management, and tunnel-specific parameters.

methods.name: test_6in4_rfc1918
methods.description: Checks if a given IPv4 address is within private or special-use ranges, such as RFC 1918 or RFC 6598.

methods.name: proto_6in4_update
methods.description: Runs a command with a timeout, used for updating tunnel information.

methods.name: proto_6in4_add_prefix
methods.description: Adds an IPv6 prefix to the configuration.

methods.name: proto_6in4_setup
methods.description: Configures the IPv6-over-IPv4 tunnel with provided parameters, setting addresses, routes, and other tunnel options.

methods.name: proto_6in4_teardown
methods.description: Tears down or cleans up the tunnel configuration.

methods.name: proto_6in4_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration variables and schema for the 6in4 protocol.
